fiber.title: Start with Vegetables
fiber.description: Fiber from vegetables coats your intestinal wall, creating a natural barrier that slows sugar absorption by up to 70%.
fiber.tip: Eat your salad, som tam, or stir-fried veggies first!

protein.title: Protein & Healthy Fats Next
protein.description: Protein triggers the GLP-1 hormone, slowing gastric emptying and improving insulin response.
protein.tip: Enjoy your grilled chicken, fish, or tofu second!

carbs.title: Then Carbohydrates
carbs.description: With the fiber shield and protein buffer in place, carbs are absorbed much more slowly.
carbs.tip: Now enjoy your rice, noodles, or bread!

sweets.title: Sweets Last (If You Want)
sweets.description: When eaten last, sweets have the least impact on your blood sugar thanks to everything you ate before.
sweets.tip: Dessert is safe when your body is prepared!
